+"""Generate and verify the frozen stack_blocks_three trajectory."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_traj import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    s = Session('stack_blocks_three', instance='/app/instance.json')
+    from envs.utils import ArmTag
+    env = s.env
+
+    def poses(label):
+        print(label, 'plan_success=', env.plan_success, flush=True)
+        for name in ['block1', 'block2', 'block3']:
+            p = getattr(env, name).get_pose()
+            print(name, p.p.tolist(), p.q.tolist(), flush=True)
+
+    def move(action):
+        if not env.move(action):
+            raise RuntimeError('Motion planning failed')
+
+    def settle(n=100):
+        for _ in range(n):
+            s.step()
+
+    poses('initial')
+    s.record_start()
+    blocks = [env.block1, env.block2, env.block3]
+    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
+        arm = ArmTag('left' if block.get_pose().p[0] < 0 else 'right')
+        grasp = env.grasp_actor(block, arm, pre_grasp_dis=0.08, grasp_dis=0.0)
+        print('grasp', i, str(arm), [(a.action, a.target_pose) for a in grasp[1]], flush=True)
+        move(grasp)
+        settle(50)
+        poses('grasped ' + str(i))
+        move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.12))
+        poses('lifted ' + str(i))
+        if i == 0:
+            target = [0, -0.13, 0.741 + env.table_z_bias, 0, 1, 0, 0]
+        else:
+            base = blocks[i - 1].get_pose().p
+            target = [float(base[0]), float(base[1]), float(base[2] + 0.025), 0, 1, 0, 0]
+        place = env.place_actor(block, arm, target, functional_point_id=0,
+                                pre_dis=0.08, dis=0.005, constrain='free', pre_dis_axis='fp')
+        print('place', i, [(a.action, a.target_pose) for a in place[1]], flush=True)
+        move(place)
+        settle(100)
+        poses('placed ' + str(i))
+        move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.13))
+        move(env.back_to_origin(arm))
+        settle(100)
+        poses('retreated ' + str(i))
+
+    move(env.open_gripper(ArmTag('left')))
+    move(env.open_gripper(ArmTag('right')))
+    settle(250)
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    status = s.status()
+    print('RECORDED', status, actions.shape, flush=True)
+    if not status['success']:
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'attempt.npz')
+        raise RuntimeError('Stack unsuccessful')
+    replay = s.replay(actions)
+    print('REPLAY', replay, flush=True)
+    if not replay['success']:
+        raise RuntimeError('Replay unsuccessful')
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz', meta={'verified_replay': replay})
+    (OUT / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'recorded': status, 'replay': replay, 'shape': list(actions.shape)}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
